description: Imports and Exports Control Department - Import and Exports Control Regulations No. 18 of 2022
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the promulgation of new regulations under the Imports and Exports Control Act, specifically amending previous regulations and establishing new legal requirements for importing broken rice. It contains statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities about what he oversees beyond his title, and the core content is regulatory rather than about government personnel or structure.
